tag.th: เป็ดปักกิ่ง

places.q: 方砖厂69号炸酱面, 方砖厂胡同, 东城区, 北京

what.en: Small Shanghai home-cooking room that uses no MSG: spring onion oil noodles, red-braised pork

why.en: Counter service, fast and cheap; mind the hot soup inside before a child bites
